title: Customer notifications
description: Choose which channel and text tell your customer when a booking is received, accepted, rejected, changed, cancelled and before the visit.
forbidden: Viewing customer notifications needs the settings read permission.
load_failed: Notification settings could not be loaded.
event_hints.requested: When an online request awaiting approval arrives; includes the customer panel link.
event_hints.accepted: When a booking is created or a request is accepted, once per booking.
event_hints.rejected: When a pending request is rejected.
event_hints.cancelled: When a booking is cancelled or a request expires.
event_hints.reminder: The chosen time before the visit; an old reminder is not sent if the booking changes.
state.fallback_on: Tries the next channel if sending fails
readiness.title: Channels not ready to send: {{channels}}
readiness.description: No provider is connected for these channels. Notifications on them never count as sent; they show as "Skipped" in the history and, with fallback on, the next channel is tried.
reset_description: The channels, timing and custom texts of "{{event}}" will be removed and the defaults used.
validation.subject_too_long: The subject can be at most 200 characters.
validation.body_too_long: The text can be at most 1000 characters.
validation.offsets_required: Choose at least one reminder time.
validation.offsets_too_many: You can choose at most {{count}} reminders.
editor.enabled_hint: When off, the customer gets no message for this event.
editor.channels_hint: The message goes out on the first channel. Without a phone number or e-mail, or when a channel is not ready, the next one is tried.
editor.fallback_hint: Try the next channel when one fails or is skipped.
editor.offsets_hint: How long before the visit to remind; at most {{count}} times.
editor.texts_hint: An empty text, or one equal to the default, goes back to the default. Your business name is part of the message.
editor.subject: Subject
editor.whatsapp_note: WhatsApp sends only the confirmation request, with the template the business had approved by Meta; for other notices this channel is skipped and the next channel is tried.
editor.preview_title: Preview with a sample customer and booking
editor.variables_hint: Variables you can use in the text:
history.load_failed: The sent history could not be loaded.
history.empty_description: Booking events and reminders are listed here, one row per channel.
history.empty_filtered_description: Change the filters or the search.
